## Elbaph

Elbaph is the strongest kingdom in the world, and the hardest to find.

Land on a wild island in the New World and complete the Log Pose missions of a wild island in the New World.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Pride of Elbaf](r_giant.md#q-1097fff591f57924)

**Tasks**

- Land on a wild island in the New World
- Complete the Log Pose missions of a wild island in the New World

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +6 Training Points (your race)
